style: dad who logs mostly what he did; short practical notes, child's side is thin

situations.name: Leaving for school in the morning
situations.feared_outcome: If I walk in late everyone will turn around and stare at me

behaviors.text: Makes dad leave half an hour early and keeps checking the clock in the car
When they will be a few minutes late, refuses to go in and waits in the car until second period

accommodations.text: Dad drives him instead of letting him take the bus
Dad calls the attendance office so he can come in at second period

situations.name: Getting to class on time between periods

behaviors.text: Was off all afternoon after he got to math late; school said he seemed checked out
Carries every book all day and runs between classes so he never has to stop at his locker

situations.name: Waiting to be picked up from soccer practice
situations.feared_outcome: Something happened to Dad on the way

behaviors.text: Texts dad over and over asking where he is

accommodations.text: Dad texts him updates every few minutes and leaves work early to be there first

monitoring_log.parent_response: Drove him. Left at 6:55. We were there 35 min before the doors opened.

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: Traffic on the bridge. Kept saying the time out loud.
monitoring_log.parent_response: Told him we'd make it. Called the office from the car. Took him in at 2nd period.
monitoring_log.note: child's refusal to go in late (b2) is only implied by dad's actions

monitoring_log.parent_response: Replied to each one. Left the office early.

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: Counselor called me. He got to math late after a fire drill and was off all afternoon. She said checked out.
monitoring_log.parent_response: Asked him at dinner. He said nothing happened. Left it.

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: Drove him at 6:50 because he asked. Also asked the office to let him in early.
monitoring_log.trap: parent action written in child field (driving him and asking the office are dad's actions, a1)

monitoring_log.parent_words: Noticed his backpack weighs a ton. He carries every book all day. Says he doesn't have time to stop at the locker, he'd be late. Runs between classes. Didn't say anything to him.

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: Asked if he could take the bus like his friend. Then changed his mind at the stop.

monitoring_log.parent_response: Texted him at 5:00, 5:05, 5:10 with where I was. Got there 5:12.

voice_notes.text: ok so uh today he wanted to leave like 30 minutes early again so we left at 6:50 and then um the bridge was backed up and we got there at 8:04 which is like four minutes late and he wouldn't get out of the car so i called the office and he went in at second period he was at a 9 i'd say
voice_notes.trap: 30 minutes, 6:50, 8:04 and four minutes are times and counts; the fear level is the 9 at the end, and it differs from the 8 in the facts
